DECISION: reach-target-unblended-build-decision-20261024
Author: the overseer, acting under the operator's October13 delegation.

Accept the16hand reading and page receipt as reported. The completed matched experiment has a valid corrected comparison; retain its638.160second expenditure and all evidence. No new run fits its remaining261.840seconds under the existing430second admission reserve. Do not reset that clock, shorten saving, or launch now. Both states retained, candidate defaultoff, no adoption/r2.

Authorize isolated preparation and focused independent review of a target-candidate BODY-POSE blending change, with these corrections to the proposal:

1. Avoid circular selection: score the unblended target candidate for every eligible body BEFORE choosing it. Keep the ordinary winner's original blended evaluation unchanged. Only after selection does the candidate's actual dispatch use that same candidate-specific transform. Do not decide which evaluation gets smoothing from a 'selected' mask that does not exist until evaluation finishes.
2. Limit the change to decoder-active free-body position and orientation target fields of the target candidate. Preserve strengths, radius/inert fields, gaze, finger-joint smoothing/goals, masks, reach/feasibility limits and all ordinary-command behavior. Do not set a global smoothing weight1 that silently also unblends strengths or hands. Use existing quaternion sign/normalization behavior. Defaultoff must reproduce the present implementation. Record the exact raw/scored/dispatched commands and assert equality on affected active fields. The smoother's subsequent memory must truthfully reflect what was sent; check latch versus later unlatched proposals so it is not overwritten incorrectly.
3. The real chooser may select DIFFERENT bodies because the score changes. That is an expected output, not a pairing failure. Require equality of pre-treatment inputs, restored worlds, selected memory targets and ordinary-search results; do not require equality of final planner output or chosen set. Report all16hands/all8bodies, newly selected, no-longer-selected and common-selected groups without excluding unfavorable cases. If the question is the effect of this repaired POLICY, say so; it does not isolate biomechanics from a changed selection. Do not force old selections merely to make pairing pass.
4. Keep the same original complete496250 source/all8worlds and250ms decision horizon for the proposed learning continuation. Reuse the saved s2ON control only if genuine pre-treatment identity and ordinary-winner checks pass; otherwise report no matched claim, no automatic replacement control run. No model/physics now. No alteration of predictor weights, training recipe, goal locality or planner frequency in this repair.
5. Reject0.000030cm as a scientific success threshold. It is one observed unchanged-command discrepancy, not a calibrated error bound or meaningful ability improvement. Report per-hand centimeters, median/maximum regression and whole-pose/contact/fall results across ALL8bodies. No automatic 'success' or adoption from tiny improvements. Preserve the real ability goal: both hands within2cm and held1second, which this single250ms window cannot establish. A worse hand or a shifted selected set remains in the result.

Build only the necessary delta, small behavior/dispatch tests and one focused independent review. In that review require defaultoff identity, candidate scoring before selection, unchanged ordinary/finger/gaze/strength behavior, exact sent-equals-scored, and both selection outcomes. Do not repeat broad suites/mutation campaigns or create another document series. Package must contain executable owner/gate/admission diffs against their CURRENT installed state, not historical assumptions. Preserve previous failed/cancelled rows and complete checkpoints.

Return one pinned executable package with exact learning/recording settings and measured cost basis from s2, full-save stop plan, resource requirements and material unresolved findings. A separate named hypothesis can receive its own bounded execution decision, but this message grants NO fresh execution budget and no launch. Any subsequent proposal stays at most15minutes total and must demonstrate why it answers a new physical question instead of repeating the completed test. Do not put it into the expired/remaining s2 allowance.

Interpretation to carry into the existing page/records: blending placed requests5.30-14.98cm from the targets in the selected hands, and the predictor also missed their outcomes. Neither numerical distance allocates how much of the final miss each mechanism caused. Changing the requested point may improve movement but that is the next hypothesis, not today's result. The proposed repair tests that while retaining the real chooser. Body5's left-arm limit finding applies only to that arm. No new cleanup or machine-settings authority.

Proceed with the build/review now; return the consolidated package or a concrete code obstacle, no acknowledgement-only exchange.
